note: Generated by scripts/derive_convergence.py. Convergence of technique is not evidence of coordination. Every figure here is a count over a named, sourced catalog; none is a similarity score.

technique_overlap.reading: The overlap is not larger than two unrelated sets of this size would produce by chance. With 3 domestic and 8 Russian-attributed tagged cases, and a single coder, these data cannot support a claim that the two sides share method. Reported as a null.

provenance_audit.finding: The Russian laundering mirror aimed at Hungary does not run on the Hungarian pro-government press: across every article it credits, those outlets appear zero times. It is not a clean zero, though — one prominent pro-government commentator's personal Telegram channel is credited 117 times (0.08%), and Hungarian nationalist-fringe channels a further 159. The domestic machine is not this mirror's raw material; a thin thread does exist.

not_computable.question: Did a frame appear on one side before the other?
not_computable.why_not: We hold no datable articles for either side. The public dataset for the mirror gives daily counts and per-source totals — not timestamps per article — and there is no comparable corpus of domestic output at all. Building one would not fix it: we would be starting a domestic clock in 2026 against a Russian record reaching back to March 2024, and 'who was first' would measure our collection dates, not the actors.

not_computable.question: How often do the same narrative frames co-occur across both sides?
not_computable.why_not: Co-occurrence needs two corpora sampled the same way. The domestic campaign's dominant format was organic AI video on Facebook, which no archive retains — so any domestic corpus we could assemble would be text, and would systematically miss the actual artefacts. Coding one side and eyeballing the other would manufacture a number, not measure one.

not_computable.question: Why not just publish the direction we can see?
not_computable.why_not: Because every known bias here points the same way. The Russian side's clock is an ungated real-time feed while a newsroom has a publishing cycle; domestic outlets retract under legal pressure while a laundering mirror never does, so survivorship removes domestic early occurrences preferentially; and the domestic campaign's authorship happened inside a video edit, which carries no timestamp anywhere. An arrow drawn from this data would point at Russia whether or not that is true.
